rationale: registerEmbeddedFont registers only bytes sealed into a panel under their script-relative name, under an empty capability grant; codegen emits it for fonts localized beside the script and keeps the Filesystem-gated registerFont only for absolute-path fonts; both bridge font paths share one size- and signature-checked helper that never reads a path and refuses a family another owner registered; a path-backed ScriptedUI session seals the font files beside its script the way the build embeds them. Vellum's framework transfer is in effect, so this Pulp edit is not re-exported; the matching change is planned for Vellum's framework/ and made there first.
